content:
STAGE: design-space scan before committing (goal: pick a hyperbolic SID-table metric that is contract-clean and unlike prefix-count/Q_H).
READ: task contract only (no data access: read of the round dir was permission-rejected; no filesystem write/shell available).
OBSERVED: the contract forces (a) a load-bearing curved op, (b) inputs limited to SID codes + frozen reference reps + train split, (c) no free constant, (d) one scalar. Known results pin Q_H(level1)=+0.634 and degrade at levels 2/3 to +0.287/+0.393, so any useful new metric must live at level 1 and must not be a re-parameterisation of prefix ranking or of bucket counts.
CANDIDATES REJECTED: (i) prefix-cell Frechet dispersion / same-cell cohesion -> collapses to same-bucket ratio, already weak; (ii) radial depth calibration log(freq) vs ball radius -> degenerate optimum when one cell contains everything, and needs an arbitrary sign; (iii) level-2/3 margins -> cells become item ids, mirrors Q_H degradation.
CHOSEN AXIS: treat level-1 codes as a hyperbolic Voronoi partition of the *source* ball and score the geodesic margin of each item's own cell barycentre against its nearest rival cell. This is a classification-margin statistic (nearest-centroid separability of first-token codes) rather than a probability ranking, so it is not a re-expression of Q_H, and it uses cohesion AND separation rather than counts.
STILL OPEN: numerical guards (boundary clip, singleton cells) and the derivation of the ball scale from training norms rather than a tuned constant.

STAGE: final answer, recorded verbatim (HYP-VORONOI-MARGIN).
READ: nothing further; no run performed (metric is analytic on the table).
OBSERVED / DECIDED: curvature fixed at -1 (c=1) so no scale freedom; ball injection p=tanh(|x|/s)x/|x| with s=median training source norm (scale-covariance makes the comparison invariant to the reference's arbitrary embedding norm, which a Euclidean margin is not); cell centres are exact Klein-model Einstein midpoints (closed form, deterministic, no iteration); score is the mean normalised geodesic margin in [-1,1].
EVIDENCE: derivation is self-contained in the answer block; cost is one N x K arcosh distance block (6.29M entries, 25 MB float32, seconds) so the under-a-minute and one-scalar constraints hold.
REASONING: predicted monotone link to Recall@10 is via first-token recoverability: if the correct level-1 code is the geodesic nearest cell centre to the query source rep with a wide margin, a partially-correct decode still lands in the right cell; wide margins also mean cells are not interleaved, so the exponential volume of the ball is actually being partitioned rather than shared.
FAILURE MODE on record: balanced random permutation of codes (all cell barycentres collapse to the global barycentre near the origin) yields M ~ 0 with only numerical noise; single-code tables are defined as M=-1.
OPEN: whether source-side or target-side reps are the right side for Stage-3; chose source side because the query is the source and the decoded code must match the target's SID.
